title: Extended Redstone
description: A mod that adds more redstone blocks with unique functionality
body:

### ⚙️ **About:**

This mod adds new redstone blocks with unique interactions. looking for a new redstone experience? that's the mod for you.

### ⚙️ **Features:**

**Magnet:** Place 2 magnet blocks in front of each other ond power one, the magnets will connect and the magnet on the other end will activate and power redstone. The magnets only have a reach of 5 blocks but can work with blocks in between them. 

![magnet crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5be553be745ee48ef3432957d12c1eacf0482880_0.webp)

**Pulser:** The pulser will emit a short redstone pulse from evey side repeatedly once a certain amount of time has passed, this time is determined by how many items you put in it. Every item added is one game tick.

![pulser crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95505bcacd8fca41e0d6fe484f983583bec9fc3f_0.webp)
